block_instructions: Ask me before: install the packages my project already lists (npm install, pip install -r). My notes: only from the lockfile
Ask me before: add a new package or library my project did not use before.
Ask me before: delete build artifacts / cache folders that regenerate.
Ask me before: make local git commits (save points) as you work.
Ask me before: push commits to GitHub.
Ask me before: merge changes into my main branch.
Never: force-push or rewrite shared git history.
Ask me before: delete a GitHub / GitLab repo.
Ask me before: change a repository from private to public.
Ask me before: tag a release.
Ask me before: change my live database structure (tables, columns, migrations).
Ask me before: run SQL or scripts that change data directly in my live database.
Ask me before: drop tables, or wipe or bulk-delete data, in my live database.
Ask me before: issue customer refunds.
Ask me before: switch payments from test mode to live mode (for example, in Stripe).
Ask me before: change prices, plans, or products in my payment provider.
Ask me before: deploy to a preview or staging site (not my live one).
Ask me before: redeploy a preview or staging site I already approved.
Never: deploy updates to my live site or app.
Ask me before: roll my live site back to an earlier version when something breaks.
Ask me before: change environment variables or secrets in my hosting dashboard (Vercel, Netlify, Supabase).
Ask me before: change DNS or domain registration settings.
Ask me before: delete cloud VMs, buckets, or DNS records.
Ask me before: write secrets into the git repo.
Ask me before: create committed .env files with real values.
Ask me before: export browser cookies or session files.
Ask me before: pull passwords out of my computer's password store (Keychain, Credential Manager).
Ask me before: install apps or packages system-wide.
Never: run commands as administrator (sudo).
Ask me before: run install scripts copied from a website (like curl ... | bash) before I have read them.
Ask me before: add MCP servers, plugins, or extensions to my AI coding tool.
Ask me before: change device settings such as power, appearance, or network settings.
Ask me before: create or edit background services or scheduled jobs.
Ask me before: approve new device permissions such as screen recording or access to files.
Ask me before: disable security protections such as malware checks or firewall rules.
Ask me before: run bulk deletion commands in personal folders.
Ask me before: wipe a device or volume.
